fut.text: Liliana Vess takes control of the Chain Veil on Shandalar, then hunts Griselbrand to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.
Along the way Jace defects from the Infinite Consortium and joins her to dethrone Tezzeret.

m10.text: Liliana Vess is a necromancer who commands the dead and has no patience for complaints from her raised servants.
Kothophed sends her to Shandalar to find the Chain Veil, and with the veil's power she dispatches Garruk in the Onakke temple.
Then she turns on Kothophed and blows him apart, and her tattoos begin to bleed.

m11.text: Garruk hunts the Ursoth, then rages at Liliana for killing one of his beasts and assaults her in an Onakke temple.
Liliana answers with the Chain Veil, overpowering Garruk and cursing him.

m12.text: Magic 2012 leaves Liliana out of its planeswalker lineup, with Gideon and Sorin taking the places of Ajani and Liliana.
The columnist promises she will return to the spotlight soon.

isd.text: Liliana Vess comes to Innistrad to hunt her three remaining demon masters, having already used the Chain Veil to destroy Kothophed and curse Garruk.

Griselbrand is one of those masters, and he has gone missing, so she tracks down the Skirsdag leader Volpaig for answers, and he slips and reveals that only the dead Mikaeus knew where Griselbrand was.
Liliana raises Mikaeus as a zombie and learns Griselbrand is imprisoned in the Helvault, so she pressures Thalia until she chooses to save her men, which causes the Sundering of the Helvault.

Freed, Griselbrand flees Avacyn, but Liliana corners him, sees through his promises and kills him for good with the Chain Veil, while Garruk, cursed and hunting her, only manages to slay her undead swarm and let her escape.

dka.text: Liliana Vess learns that Griselbrand is on Innistrad and plans to confront the Church's highest echelons.
While Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben, Liliana raises the slain Lunarch Mikaeus as a zombie and forces him to reveal the Helvault's secrets.

She then threatens Thalia's soldiers until Thalia destroys the Helvault, freeing Avacyn and the demons, while Garruk, transforming under the Chain Veil's curse, tracks her to Innistrad and vows she cannot hide on the dark plane.

avr.text: Liliana Vess arrives seeking demons and finds a plane of angels.
Her search leads through Stensia and Nephalia to the Skirsdag cult in Thraben, where she forces Thalia to open the Helvault, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
She uses the Chain Veil to obliterate Griselbrand permanently, even as she begins to doubt the veil and Garruk, afflicted by her curse, pursues her across Innistrad.

m15.text: Liliana arrives on Shandalar tormented by the Chain Veil's voices and heads for the Onakke catacomb she has visited before, remembering how she used the veil to kill Kothophed and then Griselbrand.

At the catacomb she kills a guarding angel, then tries to return the veil to its altar but cannot let go of it, and the veil ends up hanging from her arm even after she raises and destroys an Onakke skeleton.
An Onakke spirit calls her a vessel and says everything she has done has been to avoid following Josu into the void; she drains the veil's power to snuff it out, but she still cannot drop it.
She leaves Shandalar still carrying the veil, fearing she has taken into herself the thing she spent her life avoiding.

ori.text: Liliana Vess's origin begins with her brother Josu, who is afflicted by a magical illness in battle, and the Raven Man appears to offer a cure.

Her cure drives Josu insane and poisons him anew, so she turns his victims into zombies to fight him, and her spark ignites, sending her to Innistrad, where she hones her necromancy on the undead and sometimes the living.
Bolas brokers her deal with four demons, and she later works with the Infinite Consortium, secretly betraying Jace's location, because she needs the Consortium to escape her pact.
Jace turns on the Consortium and dismembers Tezzeret, and Bolas deems Liliana's failure a breach and offers service for freedom, which she rejects.

soi.text: Jace comes to Liliana Vess on Innistrad, apologizing and then admitting he is looking for Sorin Markov, which surprises her.
She warns him that Sorin is ancient, ruthless and powerful and sets her zombie servants on him to make her point before sending him home.

Later Jace returns with accusations that she redirected the stones to herd the angels, and when she realizes he can see the Raven Man she strikes him with a bolt of magic, while the Chain Veil's backlash racks her as he presses a mental assault.

She tells him she does not want to hurt him, insists she had nothing to do with the Drownyard, and after Emrakul's madness spreads she raises a zombie army against the Horrors and joins the Gatewatch.

emn.text: Liliana Vess tries to tame the Chain Veil with lightning and geists, but the circuit fails and the veil's pain overwhelms her.

Olivia and Sorin accuse her of freeing the Lithomancer, but she answers that death is hers, and she walks toward Thraben raising the dead from cemeteries along the road, declaring herself this world's last hope.

At the Battle of Thraben her zombie army forms a perimeter around the planeswalkers and she wipes out the mutated creatures with the Chain Veil, rescuing the Gatewatch even though Nissa and Gideon recoil from the veil.

Facing Emrakul she draws deeply on the veil and fights until her body fails, and after Emrakul is sealed in the moon she survives, curses it to rot there forever and swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity.

cn2.text: Liliana Vess keeps her own lodgings, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for, and wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
She tells Dovin Baan that the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, and later persuades Chandra to come shopping with her.

Their search for a renegade turns into mingling and dancing, until Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer, and they flee out the back of the nightclub.
When Chandra tells her about her parents' deaths Liliana urges her to find Baral and burn him, and on the train she grabs the hooded man and names him Tezzeret with disgust.

kld.text: On Kaladesh Liliana Vess meets Tezzeret again, and he names her Vess in return.
She goads Chandra to show how hot her fire can burn, and when the Consulate takes Pia, Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat and cruelly tells an angry Nissa that Chandra ran from her.
She then calls Jace to Kaladesh, telling him Tezzeret is alive and demanding he bring the muscle.

She goes alone and unarmed to duel Tezzeret in the portal chamber, drains his life with the Chain Veil and pins him under her heel to learn that he works for Bolas, who is on Amonkhet, the home of her demon Razaketh, before the explosion buries her in rubble.

aer.text: Liliana Vess fights Tezzeret in a final battle at the Planar Bridge, overwhelming him there while Chandra and Gideon destroy it.
Tezzeret escapes with the portal's core, and Liliana and Saheeli break into the Aether Spire to rescue Rashmi.

akh.text: Liliana Vess leads the Gatewatch to Amonkhet to find Bolas, though she admits she knows little of where he is, and she is swallowed whole by a giant sand wurm.
She emerges wreathed in the Chain Veil's light, saved without her knowing by the Raven Man, who took command of the veil to blast her out.
In the city she and Jace see Razaketh depicted guarding the gate, and she admits she is hunting him, so Jace angrily accuses her of breaking the Gatewatch's trust by hiding her demons.

Razaketh commands her to come to him and her body wades into the river of blood against her will, until Gideon and Jace free her and she raises the river's dead animals and devours Razaketh by possessing dead crocodiles.

dom.text: Liliana Vess arrives on Dominaria with Gideon after the Gatewatch's defeat, admitting her last demon, Belzenlok, is there, and Nissa and Chandra leave.
She learns the lich leading the Cabal is her brother Josu, whom she made undead as a girl, and Gideon agrees to help lay him to rest.
She draws Josu to the manor and the Chain Veil destroys him, and with his last words he blames her for the curse of the House of Vess.
Belzenlok is killed with the Blackblade, but Bolas inherits Liliana's contract and takes her off Dominaria.

war.text: Bolas makes Liliana Vess general of his Dreadhorde, and she leads it through the Planar Bridge Tezzeret opens, until she betrays Bolas and takes command of the Dreadhorde while wearing the Chain Veil.
Jace and others try to assassinate her and nearly succeed until Bolas saves her by destroying the buildings under them.
Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, breaking her contract and forfeiting her life, and she frees Oketra and Bontu, who attack Bolas of their own volition.
Gideon takes her demonic contract upon himself and dies in her place, and with Niv-Mizzet's help Bontu sparks Bolas away, leaving Liliana free.

m21.text: Liliana Vess praises Jace's disappearing acts.

jmp.text: Liliana Vess is freed of a contract that only her binder's death could end.

cmr.text: Garruk Wildspeaker confronts Liliana Vess in a dark plane.

stx.text: Liliana Vess teaches at Strixhaven as Professor Onyx, walking the Biblioplex unrecognized by the other professors.
She catches a masked Oriq intruder stealing books, who strikes her arm with a sickening spell and warns that her days are numbered.
She visits the dragon Beledros holding a tip of Gideon's sural blade and begs him to help give Gideon back his life, but he refuses.

When the Oriq attack the campus she reflects a life-draining spell back onto its caster, recruits the twins to help her, and leads them to the Snarl, where Extus sends her to the forest outside campus with a translocation spell.

dmu.text: Liliana Vess is visited in a dream by the Raven Man, who calls her to come home, and her research in the Biblioplex convinces her he is real, so she resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake and planeswalks to Dominaria.
At the ruined Vess estate she names him Lim-Dul and learns he wants her as Dominaria's weapon.

Confronted by the Phyrexian Elas il-Kor and her soldiers, who are excavating for an object, she raises the swamp's dead against them and sees through the ring's power that she was meant to be the Raven Man's next vessel, but she refuses.
She buries the ring deeper beneath Dominaria to deny the Phyrexians and returns to Arcavios, while the Raven Man watches her go, content that he manipulated her into protecting him.

fra.text: Liliana Vess is held in a cell where she cannot use her necromancy, and her double Professor Opal taunts her about being overwritten.
Tam visits her and learns that overwriting will suffocate the original Multiverse, then later frees her by undoing the master hex.
Liliana strangles Opal, raises her as a lich, and goes to try to talk Jace down, telling the Theorist she was once him and knows power brings emptiness.
Jace gives each friend a final message, and Liliana forgives him, then kneels and mourns him when he dies and helps haul his body through the mage-ring away from the false Multiverse.
